name: gbrain
title: gbrain
description: Query, search, think, and save web pages/PDFs into your gbrain knowledge brain via the local gbrain CLI.
author: Hyunmin

commands.name: query
commands.title: Query Brain
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Hybrid (semantic + keyword) search across brain pages.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Brain
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Fast keyword search across brain pages.

commands.name: think
commands.title: Think
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Multi-hop cited synthesis across pages, takes, and graph.

commands.name: save-url
commands.title: Save URL to Brain
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Fetch a web page or PDF, extract its text, and save it as a brain page. Fails loudly if fetch or parsing fails.

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Capture Note
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Capture a quick note into the brain inbox.

commands.name: remember
commands.title: Remember Fact
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Save a fact about an entity.

commands.name: recall
commands.title: Recall Facts
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Find saved facts by question or entity.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Brain Status
commands.subtitle: gbrain
commands.description: Show which brain the extension is connected to and diagnose setup.

preferences.name: gbrainHome
preferences.title: GBRAIN_HOME
preferences.description: gbrain config directory. Empty = read GBRAIN_HOME from your login shell (~/.zshrc).

preferences.name: gbrainPath
preferences.title: gbrain binary
preferences.description: Absolute path to the gbrain executable.

preferences.name: extraPath
preferences.title: Extra PATH
preferences.description: Colon-separated directories prepended to PATH (gbrain needs bun).

preferences.name: urlSlugPrefix
preferences.title: Saved URL slug prefix
preferences.description: Default slug folder for saved web pages.

preferences.name: pdfSlugPrefix
preferences.title: Saved PDF slug prefix
preferences.description: Default slug folder for saved PDFs.
